title: LIVORA
description:
LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation about building a life under modern pressure — and living with everything your decisions create.

Choose where your story begins, decide what matters most, and try to build a future that feels stable, meaningful and truly yours. Manage money, work, relationships, health, family, time, energy and long-term goals as everyday decisions gradually shape the person you become.

Every part of your life is connected. Working longer hours may improve your finances but damage your wellbeing. Helping someone you care about may leave your own responsibilities unfinished. Playing it safe can protect what you have, while taking a risk could change everything.

There is rarely a perfect choice. Only the life your decisions create.

BUILD YOUR LIFE, ONE DAY AT A TIMEBegin from a range of starting lives, each with different circumstances, responsibilities, pressures and opportunities.

Your starting point influences the challenges ahead, but it does not decide who you will become. Every day gives you new choices about how to spend your time, protect your priorities and respond when life refuses to follow the plan.

Answer messages, join conversations, manage bills, plan your day, request annual leave, book holidays, pursue career opportunities, build relationships, care for your health and decide how much of yourself you are willing to give to the people and responsibilities around you.

Some days will feel manageable. Others will force you to choose what can wait — and what cannot.

MAKE DIFFICULT TRADE-OFFSLife in LIVORA is shaped by competing priorities.

Earn more money or protect your energy.

Work towards a promotion or make time for the people around you.

Pay an urgent bill or keep enough money aside to survive the rest of the month.

Take a risk, play it safe, help someone else or put yourself first.

Some choices improve your situation immediately. Others create pressure that may not appear until much later.

What feels like the sensible decision today could become tomorrow’s regret. A sacrifice that hurts now may protect the future you are trying to build.

YOUR LIFE REMEMBERSChoices in LIVORA are not isolated events that disappear once the moment has passed.

Ignored messages, missed payments, broken promises, delayed decisions, damaged relationships, career sacrifices, health problems and unfinished business can return days, months or years later.

People remember how you treated them. Financial problems build if they are ignored. Work pressure can affect life outside your job. Decisions made during difficult moments can follow you into completely different stages of your life.

A small choice may become an opportunity, a lasting consequence or a problem you still need to face.

MANAGE A CONNECTED LIFEYour decisions can affect:

• Money, bills, savings and debt
• Work, career progression and job security
• Energy, physical health and mental load
• Relationships, friendships and family
• Stability, confidence, wellbeing and self-respect
• Time, annual leave, holidays and planned events
• Business opportunities and long-term ambitions
• Unfinished responsibilities and future consequences

These systems do not exist separately.

Financial pressure can damage your health. Career decisions can strengthen or strain your relationships. A difficult period at work can follow you home. Time spent helping someone else may leave your own problems unresolved.

Keeping one part of life stable may require sacrificing another.

PLAN YOUR TIMEYou cannot do everything in one day.

Use the Day Planner to decide where your time and attention should go. Handle urgent responsibilities, follow opportunities, make space for recovery or spend time maintaining the relationships that matter to you.

Your plans may involve work, appointments, financial tasks, social commitments and personal needs. Each decision uses time, energy or money, and choosing one path may mean leaving something else behind.

The challenge is not simply completing tasks. It is deciding which parts of your life deserve your attention before they begin to fall apart.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS AND STAY CONNECTEDThe people around you are part of the life you are building.

Respond to messages, take part in conversations, support friends and family, handle disagreements and decide when to be honest about what you can realistically give.

Relationships can grow stronger through attention, trust and shared experiences. They can also become strained by neglect, work pressure, broken commitments or decisions that repeatedly place other priorities first.

What you say matters. What you avoid saying can matter just as much.

MANAGE MONEY UNDER PRESSUREMoney affects almost every part of life.

Handle rent, bills, debt, unexpected costs and everyday spending while trying to protect your future. Decide what must be paid now, what can wait and whether taking on more work is worth the personal cost.

A healthy income does not always create a stable life. Higher earnings may come with greater responsibility, less free time and more pressure. A cheaper decision may solve today’s problem while creating a larger one later.

Financial choices can influence your wellbeing, relationships, opportunities and ability to recover when life changes unexpectedly.

SHAPE YOUR CAREER AND FUTUREBuild a career, pursue promotions, protect your job security or take a different route entirely.

Work can provide money, confidence, structure and future opportunities, but it can also demand more than you expected. Decide how ambitious you want to be, what you are willing to sacrifice and when a stable position is no longer enough.

You may choose to climb higher, change direction, protect your personal life or work towards building something of your own.

Success is not measured only by salary. It is measured by what the life behind that salary has become.

WATCH YOUR LIFE CHANGEAs weeks, years and life stages pass, LIVORA tracks the patterns created by your decisions.

See which choices protected you, which sacrifices cost the most, what areas of life you repeatedly neglected and how your circumstances have changed over time.

Weekly and long-term reports help reveal the story behind your statistics. A life can appear stable while still carrying unresolved pressure. A difficult period may become the foundation for something better.

Your story is shaped by more than success or failure. It is shaped by what you consistently choose to protect — and what you allow to slip away.

LIVE IN A WORLD THAT KEEPS MOVINGLife does not pause while you decide what to do next.

Seasons change. Weather can affect daily plans and decisions. World News brings fictional events, sports results and wider developments that make the world feel active beyond your own life.

Economic pressure, new technology and major events can create disruption, uncertainty and fresh opportunities. The world continues to move forward, whether you are ready for it or not.

Your life has to move with it.

START AGAIN AND CHOOSE DIFFERENTLYEvery new life is an opportunity to approach things differently.

Choose another starting point. Handle money with more care. Prioritise your relationships. Protect your health. Chase ambition. Take greater risks. Build a family. Start a business. Make the choices you avoided before.

A single different decision can change what happens next. A different pattern of choices can create an entirely different life.

There is no single correct way to play LIVORA. The question is not whether you made every perfect decision.

The question is what kind of life your decisions created.

FEATURES• Choice-driven life simulation
• Multiple starting lives and difficulty levels
• Decisions with immediate and delayed consequences
• Money, bills, debt and financial pressure
• Career progression, work pressure and job security
• Relationships, friendships, health and family systems
• Messages and playable conversations
• Day planning, annual leave, holidays and scheduled events
• Changing weather, World News and future developments
• Weekly and long-term life reports
• Multiple paths, outcomes and replayable lives
• Text-led gameplay designed for thoughtful, relaxed play

Build a life. Survive the cost.
description_short: LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation where money, work, relationships, health, family, weather, world events and pressure all connect. Build a life, face the consequences, recover from mistakes, chase ambition, fall in love, start again, and see how different every life can become.
